def check_win_at(board: np.ndarray, move: Tuple[int,int,int], player: int) -> bool:
    """Check if placing player at move wins the game."""

    for line_idx in CELL_TO_LINES[move]:

        if all(board[a,b,c] == player for (a,b,c) in line):
            won = True
            break
    board[i,j,k] = 0
    return won

def evaluate_board(board: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Evaluate board state from perspective of player 1."""
    score = 0
    for line in LINES:
        vals = [board[i,j,k] for (i,j,k) in line]
        if 1 in vals and -1 in vals:

        if theirs == 3:

        elif theirs == 1:

    return score

def minimax(board: np.ndarray, depth: int, alpha: float, beta: float, is_maximizing: bool) -> float:

            if beta <= alpha:
